patch_description: The current program's bottleneck is smoothness (0.36) and slope changes (36) / false reversals (29), while responsiveness (0.71) and lag (0.41) are acceptable. The lead compensation in Stage 4 reintroduces some residual oscillation into the smoothed signal. Adding a light, unconditional third SG pass (half = max(2, sg_half//3), order 2) after the lead compensation — before the trim — suppresses these residual oscillations at negligible lag cost, since the pass is zero-phase (no group delay) and its window is short. We reuse `_zero_phase_smooth` verbatim (it already handles reflect padding and degenerate lengths) and validate the output length after the pass as a safety net. This directly targets the remaining headroom in smoothness and false reversals without sacrificing the already-strong correlation/responsiveness tradeoff.
